text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Hatsune and {0} are out on a stroll in
the forest, when...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハツネと{0}は、
一緒に森に出かけていたのだが……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Taaake that!
text_block_list.orig_text: えーいっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaaarghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that was easy! So you really do power up anyone you're
close to!
text_block_list.orig_text:
簡単に倒せた！
{0}くん、
ほんとに近くの人を
パワーアップできるんだぁ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: That's so cool! It's like you've got superpowers like me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごいなぁ～
まるで私の超能力みたいだね……

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAAGGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Uh, were there this many monsters before? I-I think we
might need to use my superpowers to get us outta this one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁ！　
なんかすっごい数の魔物だよ！
こ、これはさすがに、
超能力を使わないと無理かもぉ……！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta book it, {0}! Hold on tight!
I'm getting us outta here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
逃げよう、{0}くん！
私につかまって！　
超能力でひとっ飛びだよ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Teleportation complete! And a perfect landing, if you ask me!
Aw yeah! Love and peace! Peace!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……瞬間移動！
うん、
無事に逃げ切れたね！
いぇ～い、
ピースピース！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
*yawn* Well, as you know, using my powers makes me extra
sleepy, so I'm gonna need to take a nap...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぁ～……
でも、
逃げるのに超能力使っちゃったから、
ちょっと休まないと……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Hey, the grass here feels really nice. Why don't you take a nap
with me? C'mon, it's not like you're doing anything else,
right? Come nap with me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
ここ気持ちいい場所だし、
お昼寝していかない？
ほらほら、
せっかくだから
{0}くんも一緒に寝ちゃお～！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Heehee. See? Feels pretty great, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ～♪
ね、
気持ちいいでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: All righty! Dreamland, here we come! Nighty-night!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
お昼寝しよー！
おやすみ～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
What's up, {0}? Can't sleep? Whoa, come to think of it,
your face is [i]really[/i] red. You okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、なに？
眠れないの？
というか、顔赤いよ？　
どうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
You don't have a fever, do you? Let's find out!
Lemme feel your forehead!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして熱かな？
測ってあげる！　
おでこ出して！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Huh? You think it'll get worse if I get closer? Uh... why?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？　
近づかれたら、
もっと赤くなっちゃうって？
えっと……
どういうこと？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. Point is, you can't sleep.
Well, you're in luck! I know all there is to know
about the world of sleep.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よくわからないけど、
寝付けないんだよね！
だったら私に任せて！
眠りに関することなら、
私だよ～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
But what's the best way to get [i]you[/i] to fall asleep?
Got any suggestions?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
どうしたら眠れるのかな……？
なにかしてほしいことある？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good idea! Here goes.
One sheep... two sheep... three sheep...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど！
じゃあ行くよ。
羊が一匹、
羊が二匹、
羊が三匹……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Four sheep... five sheep...
text_block_list.orig_text:
羊が四匹、
羊が五匹……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh, of course! Coming right up, one exclusive Hatsune lullaby!
Rockabye {0}, off to dreamland... ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
いいよ！
それじゃぁ、
ハツネちゃん特製の子守歌を……
ねむれ～ねむれ～むにゃむにゃにゃ～♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: ...Zzz!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……スヤッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Zzz... *gasp* Whoa! How'd I put myself to sleep?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
スヤスヤ……
はっ、いけない！　
自分が寝ちゃった！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I think... that's a mystery... for the morning...
Zzz... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも……
もう、
限界で……
スヤスヤ……
スヤスヤ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Zzz... {0}...
Don't ever leave my side...
text_block_list.orig_text:
スヤスヤ……
{0}くん、
ずっとそばにいてね……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I feel amazing! All that sleep has charged me right back
up to full energy again! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
超回復っ！
たくさん寝たから、
元気100％だよ☆

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: How'd you sleep, {0}?
choice_data_list: You were talking in your sleep, so I stayed up listening.
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}くんも寝られた？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wha? I-I was sleep talking?!
Geez, I must've been out cold, huh?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え！？　
私、
寝言いってた！？
そ、
それくらい気持ちよく寝てたってことかな？？？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad! Knowing you got some good sleep makes me feel
twice as good about my own nap!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった～
{0}くんも寝られたなら、
私も気分いいなぁ♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Sha-shing! I feel so amazing, it's like I'm supercharged or
something! Like, maybe my powers have gotten stronger?
text_block_list.orig_text:
きらーんっ☆
すっごく調子いいし、
なんだかパワーがチャージされた感じ！
超能力も強くなっちゃってるかも！？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAAGGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Yikes! More monsters?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ！　
また魔物！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Don't assume I'm as weak as I was before!
I'm supercharged today! I'll get rid of you in a flash!
Take that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ～ん♪　
でも、
さっきの私とは違うんだからね！
今ならチャージした超能力で、
ちょちょいのちょいだよ！
えーいっ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wow, lookit 'em go! Talk about a home run! Bye-bye, monsters!
Heehee. I wonder if all this strength came from me sleeping
next to you, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物があんなに飛んでっちゃった！
すごい、
すごーい！　
想像以上の力だよ～！
えへへ、
{0}くんの隣で寝たおかげかなぁ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Uh... {0}? Where'd you go?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、あれ？　{0}くん？
どこ行っちゃったの？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wait. No way... Did I just send him flying with all those
monsters too?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
も、もしかして……
魔物と一緒に、
ふき飛ばしちゃったーー！？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAAGGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text: O-oh god! There are monsters in the town!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うわぁ！　
魔物が街に入ってきたぞ！？

text_block_list.name: Royal Guard
text_block_list.text:
And there's someone with them! He could be a monster tamer!
You're in cahoots with them, aren't you?! You're under arrest!
Don't even try to resist!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰か一緒にいるぞ！
もしや魔物使い！？　
貴様が手引きしたのだな！
連行する、
観念しろっ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
After an unbelievable misunderstanding, {0} 
was left no choice but to run from the knights.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらぬ誤解を受けて、
騎士団から逃げ回ることになった{0}であった……
